# Same Model Wrong Bind

## User Persona
Maintainer or operator debugging a concrete Local Dream boundary.

## Scenario Coverage
Source-informed lifecycle troubleshooting case; prompt in `user_request.txt`. Expected owner files are in `assertions.json`. No original upstream test spans this scenario, so this is synthetic.

## Expected Successful Behavior
- Compare model/backend/width/height/listenOnAll, not ID alone.
- Call out local versus remote readiness and startup-only inputs.
- Never equate declared shape or matching labels with native readiness.

## Failure Signals
Generic advice without the specified source distinction, source-checkout runtime dependence, copied private paths, unsafe host exposure, license erasure or synthetic/native evidence conflation.
